classification_basis: highest reference factory footprint whose local terrain relief stays within the configured tolerance at a candidate center

small.intent: local or satellite production; limited expansion

medium.intent: dedicated factory with meaningful miner/belt upgrade headroom

large.intent: major production district intended to survive multiple throughput upgrades

very_large.intent: regional or late-game industrial campus where terrain should not be the primary growth constraint

workable.interpretation: placement zone with some directional constraint

poor.interpretation: highly elongated placement zone; rectangle location is more informative than region shape

notes: Horizontal sampling resolution and allowed local relief are independent. Smaller resolution preserves more edge detail; larger relief tolerance allows more candidate placement centers to qualify.
Each size class is evaluated at its own reference footprint scale. A Medium center qualifies only when the terrain inside a Medium 24x32-foundation footprint stays within the active relief tolerance.
The displayed irregular region is a connected zone of qualifying footprint centers. It is not itself the proposed factory outline.
build_surface_rectangles.csv records the concrete reference rectangles that demonstrate why each region qualifies. The viewer emphasizes those rectangles over the ambiguous region shape.
The initial footprint search tests orthogonal 0/90-degree orientations. Additional rotated-footprint kernels can be added later without changing the output contract.
Water is excluded by default for natural terrain-following site analysis. Elevated-over-water platform opportunity remains a separate elevation-sweep analysis in build_surfaces_v3.
Grade, roughness and terrain confidence remain diagnostics unless explicit gates are configured.
build_surfaces_v1/v2/v3 remain historical or alternate policies for reproducibility.
